name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Lead | SaaS Configuration, Integrations & Customer Onboarding
summary: Implementation and onboarding lead with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, professional-services software, and agency environments. Owned implementations from contract through configuration, training, and go-live at Wix (25+ launches a month at 110% of implementation targets) and scoped CRM/PSA implementations with API integrations at Accelo. Today I build the integrations myself, in Zapier, Make, and n8n with custom Python and JavaScript code steps, so I can translate customer requirements into configurations engineering can trust. Built compliance systems from scratch in a state-regulated business.
